about: Report sections that ReviewQ checks when they are saved (crates/reviewq-app/src/ledger/markdown/content.rs) and the report page draws (reportTable in web/src/features/review/report/report-structure.ts, eligibleDiagram and diagramSource in web/src/components/markdown/mermaid.ts). Both sides read this file: drawn_sections_agree_with_the_page in crates/reviewq-app/src/ledger/markdown/tests.rs and web/tests/browser/drawn-sections.spec.ts.

headings: a Before and After table whose first header cell is cell. shown is that heading's text as the page compares it: trimmed as JavaScript trims and lowercased. The page draws the table as cards exactly when shown is before.

sections: drawn says whether the page draws what the section needs: a Mermaid diagram for flow, a Before and After table followed by the operations table for changes. diagrams lists, in order, the exact text the page hands Mermaid for each block it draws. digests, where given, lists the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of each, the key by which ReviewQ stores a drawing made ahead and the page looks it up. refusal is the Rust check's refusal, by line and kind.
A body is a string or a list of pieces, where {"repeat": text, "times": n} stands for text written n times.
